proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VIII Section 808
proposed.explanation: Source-audited against Rule VIII Section 808: rooms without artificial ventilation need window free area of at least 10% of floor area and at least 1.00 sq.m; toilet, bath, laundry, and similar rooms follow the separate 1/20 floor-area rule with a stated absolute minimum; roofed-porch openings require the three Section 808 conditions.
